name: .env Template Generator
description: Generate a ready-to-fill .env template for your stack — Node.js, React, Django, Laravel and more — with comments and placeholders.
body:
Generated .env

Your .env template will appear here.
howto: Pick your framework or stack from the dropdown.
Copy the template or download it as a .env file.
Fill in the real values, then save as .env (and never commit it to git).
features: Commented variable descriptions for each key
Sensible defaults for ports, environments and databases
Copy or download as a real .env file

faq.a: In the root of your project. Add it to your .gitignore so secrets are never committed — most frameworks do this automatically.

faq.q: Are these templates safe to use?
faq.a: Yes. They are standard environment variable names for each framework with empty placeholders for your real secrets.
The templates give you the common keys. Edit the file freely — .env is just plain text with KEY=value lines.
No. The template is generated entirely in your browser.
